electricity_source.actual_vs_forecast: Strictly actual realised grid load observations (Realisierte Werte)

meteorological_source.provider: Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) OpenData Climate Data Center (CDC) via Open-Meteo European Weather Archive

station_metadata.station_id_clarification: DWD Stations_ID 01420 and WMO Index 10637 both identify the Frankfurt am Main station facility. OpenData and SYNOP reports reference both cross-indexed numbers.
station_metadata.representativeness_assessment: Frankfurt am Main serves as the synoptic geographic and industrial load centroid of Germany (Rhine-Main metropolitan area). Limitations: nationwide single-station approximation does not resolve localized North Sea coastal wind offshore dynamics or Alpine thermal boundaries. Documented for future multi-station weighted polygon expansion.

variables.wind_speed_ms: 10-meter wind speed (meters per second, converted from km/h / 3.6)
variables.solar_radiation_wm2: Direct solar irradiance at surface (Watts per square meter)
